content: Peniya, ntumiche jwa kunane kwa Chapanga nganangiya lukemba lwa mache gha ughome ghighang'ala ngita lindala, ghighakokwila pa kigoda cha unahota nkolongwa gwa Chapanga na cha Mwanalimbelele,

na lukemba lono lupetite pakate jha ndela ngolongwa jha muche. Mupele jha lukemba ukibha nkongo gwa ughome ghupambika uhohe mala kome na ibhele kwa chaka yane kila mwehe. Na mahamba gha nkongo gwenio ndi ntela gwa kulamichii bhando bha ilambo henge.
Kibhii jhe kilebhe chochoha chikipala kulapanikilwa mu kilambo chenie. Mana kigoda cha Chapanga na cha Mwanalimbelele kibhii mwenio, na akatumiche bhake bhanyinamila na kuntumukila.
Nabhakubhona kumiho jhake, na liina lyake nalijhandikwa mu ibhonge yabhe.
Kibhii jhe kilo kabhele amu bhipala jhe kolobohi kabhele amu lyobha, nhwalo Bhambo Chapanga nabhamulikila na bheniya nabhalongocha machiko ghoha ghangapeta.
Kuhika kwa Yecho

Peniya, ntumiche jwa kunane kwa Chapanga nganobholila, “Malobhe ghanga ndi chakaka na ghakuhobholeka. Bhambo Chapanga jwabhapela akalondole uhuke gwake, akatumite ntumiche gwake jwa kunane kwa Chapanga bhalangiye akatumiche bhake bha pannema ghala ghighapala kupitila machiko gha kajhombe.”
Yecho ngalongila, “Nnyokanikiye! Nihika kajhombe. Jhuna mota jhola jwakamwii malobhe gha ulondole ghughabhii mu kitabo chenje!”

Ne ndi Yohane, nikaghamwene na kujhoha ilebhe henge. Punyomolila kughabhona na kughajhoha gheniya, ngandamita makilikite palonge jha magholo gha ntumiche jwa kunane kwa Chapanga jwanangiye ilebhe yenio kupala ninnyinamile.

Nambo jwenio nganobholila, “Mangahenga yenio! Ne nantumiche tugha ngita mwenga na akalongo bhino akalondole na bhando bhoha bhibhakamwii malobhe gwa ulondole ghighajhandikwe mu kitabo chenje. Chapanga ndi jwapalwa kujhinamilwa.”
Kabhele nganobholila, “Mangatenda kubhehe lupwepo lwa malobhe gwa ulondole ghighabhii mu kitabo chenje, nhwalo machiko gha kupitila kwake kubhandikile.

Ngohe munneke jwahenga ghanganandela aghagha kuhenga na jwahenga ghangapalwa na Chapanga achocha kuhenga yenio. Jwahenga ghambone ghaghapala Chapanga aghagha kuhenga ghambone na jwabhii nyahinyahi achocha kubhehe nyahinyahi.”
Yecho ajhakulonge, “Unyokanikiye nihika kajhombe! Pamonga na hupo chinimpela kila mundo tela na itendwa yake.
Nenga ndi Alufa na Omega yane jwakutumbula na jwa kujhomolela. Jwatumbulicha ilebhe yoha na jwakujhomolela ilebhe yoha.”
Mina mota bhala bhibhapula ngobho yabhe, nhwalo bheniya ndi nabhalekekewa bhalya uhohe gwa nkongo gwa ughome, na kujhingii kubomane kupete milyango jhake.
Nambo kwenio panja jha muche ibhii ghimbwa, akahabhe na akangongola na bhibhakoma na bhibhajhinamii inyagho na bhoha bhibhapala kulonge uwange na kuhenga, nabhajhingii ng'o ubomane.
“Ne ndi Yecho, nitumite ntumiche jwango anobholele ilebhe henge likunde lya bhando lilinnyeketii Kilichitu. Nenga ndi kibheluko cha lukolo lwa Daude. Nenga ndi lundondwa lola lulung'ala lukela!”
Uhuke gwa Chapanga na nnyinamwale mwikeghe bhilonge, “Nhwike!” Kila mundo jwajhoha lende alonge, “Nhwike!” Jwabhii na nyota ahike, na atole mache gha ughome changamalepo.
Kujhomolela

Ne ndi Yohane nakelebhuwa bhoha bhibhajhoha malobhe gha ulondole gha kitabo chenje, mundo jhojhoha anda ajhonjakanikii chochoha mu ilebhe henge, Chapanga nanyonjekeya mabulo ghighajhandikwe mu kitabo chenje.

Na mundo jhojhoha apongwiche chochoha mulondole gwa kitabo chenje, Chapanga nampoka lipungu lyake mu nkongo gwa ughome, na chehemo jhake mu kilambo cha nyahinyahi, ilebhe ichimulilwe mu kitabo chenje.
Jwenio ndi jwalongela uchakaka panane jha mambu ghoha ilonge, “Chakaka, nihika kajhombe.” Amina. Nhwike Bhambo Yecho!
Umbone gwa Bhambo gwito Yecho Kilichitu utama pamonga na bhando bhoha. Amina.
